caption:
Most AI workflows break when the AI provider is down or the answer isn't valid JSON.

Fix: set the AI step to continue on error, parse its answer inside try/catch, and fall back to a polite holding reply. The patient always hears back.

Real n8n run on a demo clinic site. The outage is simulated (labelled in the video).
